clientInspection.geometrySearch: Current client contained no GetFeature, GeoJSON, WFS, polygon, or coordinate-geometry transport. Actual click flow calls getPlotAtXY, ScalarDatahandler OP=4, and WMS PLOT_LIST / SAME_OWNER_PLOT_LIST image layers. OP=4 plotInfoLinks points to a per-plot Plot Report page.
clientInspection.actualClickFlow: showPlotDetails(coordinates) posts state/giscode/x/y to rest/MapInfo/getPlotAtXY; the success handler requests PLOT_LIST and SAME_OWNER_PLOT_LIST WMS images; in parallel it calls ScalarDatahandler OP=4 with state, selectedLevels(), x and y, then doSelectPlot updates the image layers and displays report links.

requests.result: Exact viewer-selected cadastral sheet extent in EPSG:32645 plus viewer GIS code.
Selected-sheet point click returns opaque ID, plot/kide number, and attributes_json; the sampled attributes_json was null. It is point identification, not feature enumeration.

The body parsed as JSON despite HTML content type. Safe fields included has_data, ID, plotNo, GIS code, info/link fields, and xmin/ymin/xmax/ymax; no polygon/WKT/coordinate/ring fields. Raw body and personal attributes were discarded.

sourceConclusion: BhuNaksha exposes rasterized cadastral map imagery, map-sheet EPSG:32645 extents, and selected-sheet single-plot click identification by opaque ID/plot number. Its current viewer client and the followed anonymous click→OP=4→highlight→Plot Report flow do not expose a complete bounded polygon feature query or machine-readable parcel boundary. A feature source/adapter cannot be justified from these responses.
scopeLimit: This is a shared Bihar source-family blocker for this viewer only. It is not a city-specific geometry investigation for all 23 Bihar targets, does not establish that Bihar has no parcel data, and does not rule out other official urban/regional services or a future download route.
reuseTerms: Not assessed; terms are informational only.
nextStep: Revisit if Bihar publishes anonymous vector parcel geometry or a bounded official download with stable village+plot IDs and completeness semantics; separately resolve each target WUP point to its official revenue village.
